summary: Six skills built in order, each with SKILL.md (67-84 lines), module.mjs, demo.mjs, test.mjs, skill.json and out/demo.mp4 + out/contact.png. All six node test.mjs runs exit 0 at full size 1080x1920 (final clean re-run): 301 unit checks in total, every demo 7.5-8 s silent, engine QC passes on the card and the mp4. I viewed each contact sheet (thumbnails) and fixed defects found there (hook touching the window in t1.3, a chip falling through the cog in t1.3, a stamp covering the toggle in t1.5). Not checked: nothing was played back by a person, only stills, pixel tests and motion-energy numbers; no audio.
knownLimits: Demos are 7.5-8 s, so the t1.2 demo pages are 1.6-1.7 s (validatePlan warns; real cards use 3-4.7 s pages).
Demos import earlier tier-1 modules (t1.1, t1.2, t1.5) for composition; every module.mjs depends on the engine only.
The engine's own 42 px warning on the Follow label during its 0.1 s pop-in remains in every QC report (a warning, not a failure).
t1.5 stamp's elastic slam first reaches scale 1 after about 2 frames then wobbles; judged from numbers and stills, not playback.

Not exercised in a demo: t1.1 resize beyond one settle, t1.2 directions other than 'right', t1.3 scatterPose gravity and shake(), t1.4 lineRunner, t1.5 signaturePad and typed field values (all unit-tested).
BGI-variant closer is verified by pixel equality with the engine and unit tests; the t1.6 demo renders the AEON variant only.
